request.subject: CITY:DINOSAUR:3

layers.text: Paint the whole roof of the cream hut on the left plain flat bright red, and recolour the small dark brown hut behind the skull on the right to plain flat bright red hide. Change nothing else: keep the giant cream rib arch, the horned skull, the bright red awning behind it, the bright red cone tents, the dark stone posts, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
